scope: Point-mass shuttle flight with quadratic drag and no lift, spin or wind. A visualization model, not a match or coaching engine.

specification.speedTest: A full underhand stroke from over the back boundary line, upward and parallel to the sidelines, must land 530 mm to 990 mm short of the other back boundary line.

reference.note: Equation of motion from clanet-2015-arfm, Eq. 6: m dv/dt = m g - 0.5 rho S Cd |v| v.
After a hit the shuttle flips in about 20 ms (16-39 ms measured); afterwards the cork leads along the velocity.
Speeds: elite players (Tsai et al. 1997, as cited); amateur speeds are unknown.

zoneReference.note: Landing zones and launch direction follow the Module 7 stroke definitions: smash hit downward into the midcourt, clear high to the rearcourt, drop to the forecourt.

reference.note: "After contact with the racket (typical time of 1 ms)".
Shuttle direction is measured from the racket-face normal; off-centre impacts deviate by up to about 3-7 degrees horizontally. The vertical relation to face pitch was not measured.

presets.note: Mean launch speeds by level. Studies differ in method (video rate, radar, instantaneous fit), so values are indicative.
